title: Macropad, module on top: MX keys and a 2.0 in display
note: The front-mount macropad built: twelve MX switches soldered to the board (no plate) with DSA keycaps, a DO-35 diode in the gap beside each, the thin module soldered flat on its castellated pads at the board's top edge (its USB-C over the edge, a cable plugged in), and a 2.0 in ST7789 display plugged straight into the module's display column on a standard socket, lying over the module, clear of the keys. The board's underside is z = 0.

fits.note: The display lies clear over the module (its parts reach about 1 mm above its board)
fits.label: Display over the module

fits.note: The display, hanging below the module, keeps back from the top row's keycaps
fits.label: Display clear of the keys
